The H1 bullish order block (76808 - 77118) and demand zone act as a major structural floor, while the 77250 minor quarter level provides psychological support, aligning with the upward-sloping H1 EMA50/200 to prevent deeper downside.

Confluence 2: Integration of Fair Value Gap (unmitigated H1 FVG between 77170.76 and 77504.01), MSNR (Malaysian SNR swap zone at 77170 - 77300), and Break of Structure (BOS above 77450) with Volatility Indicators (M15 ATR of 226.56). This zone is reinforced by a bullish trendline and the strong buying pressure shown by the earlier H1 pin bar, while the overbought M15 RSI cools down during this healthy corrective pullback.

CRT shows accumulation below the midnight open (76842) and manipulation down to 76388, followed by expansion. The current consolidation forms a bullish flag pattern just above the unmitigated demand origin, supported by rising OBV/CMF which confirms institutional buying pressure.

Confluence 5: Integration of Standard Deviation (SD bands), Fibonacci Circles, and ICT/SMC (liquidity sweep of 76622.97) with Volatility Indicators (Bollinger Bands basis/lower band on M15). The -1 to -2 Standard Deviation bands and Fibonacci circles project a key turning point around 77230. This matches the liquidity sweep level and aligns with the M15 Bollinger Bands basis, ensuring a high-probability preemptive wick rejection at the defensive staff.
